title: Four More Forms Before Your Name

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — meet one form until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write retroflex ળ once from memory. Say lla, then put it away. The new letter is the ordinary l sound.

Keep લ visible. It is la. Circle counterclockwise around the broad rounded left body. Lift once and sweep the separate middle shoulder from left to right. Lift again; descend the tall right spine and turn through its lower foot.
Finger-trace લ (la) once, then air-trace it once. Notice rounded body, separate shoulder, separate spine; two pen lifts.
Copy visible લ once. Compare only the rounded body and separate shoulder; repair one landmark if needed.
Hide the model and write la once. Uncover લ, compare, and stop after one repair.

segments.prompt: Hide the model and write ordinary la from memory.

feedback.correct: લ — the rounded body, shoulder, and spine are intact.
feedback.incorrect: Look once at લ, hide it, and repair only the differing landmark.

segments.text: Point to ordinary la in લ ળ. Then point to retroflex lla.
Sources: Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice and the Unicode Gujarati chart.

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — meet one form until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write la once from memory. Check its rounded body; the next form begins with a high hook instead.

Keep પ visible. It is pa. Begin at the high left hook, curl over it, descend the left stem, and sweep around the broad lower body into the right shoulder. Lift once; descend the tall right spine into its lower foot.
Finger-trace પ once, then air-trace it once. Notice high left hook, broad lower body, separate right spine; one pen lift.
Copy visible પ once. Compare only the high hook and lower body; repair one landmark if needed.
Hide the model and write pa once. Uncover પ, compare, and stop after one repair.

segments.prompt: Hide the model and write pa from memory.

feedback.correct: પ — the high hook and separate right spine are intact.
feedback.incorrect: Look once at પ, hide it, and repair only the differing landmark.

segments.text: Name the first landmark and the pen-lift count.
Sources: Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice and the Unicode Gujarati chart.

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — meet one form until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Point to છ and say aspirated chha with its puff. The new ચ is the shorter, unaspirated cha: no extra puff.

Keep ચ visible. It is cha. Circle the upper bowl, turn through the small middle loop, and continue around the broad lower body. Lift once; descend the separate right spine and turn through its lower foot.
Finger-trace ચ (cha) once, then air-trace it once. Notice upper bowl, small middle loop, broad lower body, separate spine; one pen lift.
Copy visible ચ (cha) once. Compare only the upper bowl and middle loop; repair one landmark if needed.
Hide the model and write unaspirated cha once. Uncover ચ, compare, and stop after one repair.

segments.prompt: Hide the model and write unaspirated cha from memory.

feedback.correct: ચ — the upper bowl and middle loop are intact.
feedback.incorrect: Look once at ચ, hide it, and repair only the differing landmark.

segments.text: Read ચ (cha) છ aloud, keeping the second sound's puff.
Sources: Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice and the Unicode Gujarati chart.

notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. segments.text: Write cha once from memory. Check its small middle loop, then put that model away.

Keep બ visible. It is ba. Circle clockwise around the rounded left body, wind through the compact inner turn, and exit across the right shoulder. Lift once; descend the tall right spine and turn through its lower foot.
Finger-trace બ (ba) once, then air-trace it once. Notice rounded outer body, compact inner turn, separate right spine; one pen lift.
Copy visible બ (ba) once. Compare only the outer body and inner turn; repair one landmark if needed.
Hide the model and write ba once. Uncover બ, compare, and stop after one repair.

segments.prompt: Hide the model and write ba from memory.

feedback.correct: બ — the rounded body and compact inner turn are intact.
feedback.incorrect: Look once at બ, hide it, and repair only the differing landmark.

segments.text: Name the inner landmark and the pen-lift count.
Sources: Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice and the Unicode Gujarati chart.

lessons.title: લ — પ — ચ — બ (la — pa — cha — ba): four more forms return
lessons.gloss: retrieve the second four name-exchange forms

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, because the lesson points at something written down
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, because the lesson points at something written down. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Keep the four cards visible. Point as you say la, pa, unaspirated cha, and ba. Notice one landmark at a time: rounded body, high hook, middle loop, compact inner turn.
Read the row once from left to right. Record a reading score out of four.

segments.prompt: Read these four consonants aloud in order: લ (la) પ (pa) ચ (cha) બ (ba).

feedback.incorrect: Name only the missed form, compare one landmark, then read the row again.

segments.text: Cover every model. Write la, pa, unaspirated cha, and ba from the four spoken cues. Record a separate writing score out of four. Aim for 4/4 in each column, with one focused repair allowed.

segments.prompt: Cover every model. Write from these sound cues: la, pa, unaspirated cha, ba.

feedback.correct: The four consonants returned without a visible model.
feedback.incorrect: Uncover only the missed form, repair one landmark, cover it, and retry once.

segments.text: Read ક ણ શ once. Cover the row, then write ka, retroflex nna, and sha from sound. Keep these older scores separate from the four-form chapter payoff; one repair is enough.

segments.prompt: Read these returning doorway forms aloud: ક ણ શ.

feedback.correct: The three older forms stayed distinct.
feedback.incorrect: Check only the missed form, cover it, and read the row once more.

segments.prompt: Cover every model. Write from these sound cues: ka, retroflex nna, sha.

feedback.correct: The three older forms returned from sound at the expanding interval.
feedback.incorrect: Uncover only the missed form, repair one landmark, cover it, and retry once.

segments.text: Read લ (la) ળ and ચ (cha) છ aloud. Keep ordinary/retroflex l and unaspirated/aspirated ch separate.
